d: The ducal park of Parma. Gentlemen and ladies of the court. Festively dressed countrymen, ahead of sack-pipers. – hunters with horns, falcons, dog-mute. – fencing playing pages. Wreath-slinging noble-birds. The ceremonial master, followed by a flag-wax and drummers, appears busy; arranges the groups, makes itself important and noticeable. The countrymen are pushed back. Pages and noble-birds are placed, all – according to the range, the places depend. Alternately disappearing and reappearing, excited and authoritarian at the same time, receives the duke and the duchess.
